title: Shopify
description: A product for a Shopify store card: rotates in 3D and opens in augmented reality. What matters most is fast loading in the storefront and a clean product look.

availableExtensions.title: KTX2 texture compression
availableExtensions.description: Converts textures to a GPU format: saves up to ~80% of video memory. Requires the platform's viewer to support KTX2 (basisu).
availableExtensions.impact: The file may grow 5–10%, but texture video memory drops several-fold.

availableExtensions.title: Draco geometry compression
availableExtensions.description: Minimal file weight (often −50% on geometry). Decodes slower than Meshopt in the browser but is supported everywhere.
availableExtensions.impact: The file is noticeably lighter; decoding on open is slower.

availableExtensions.title: Remove vertex colors
availableExtensions.description: Removes painted vertex colors. Enable only if vertex colors are not visible in the model (white channels are removed without this option too).
availableExtensions.impact: Saves 5–20% of size if colors exist; may change the look if they were used.

notes: triangles 150000 — Khronos 3D Commerce recommendation (Shopify relies on this e-commerce standard); more is allowed for hero products, but this is a reasonable limit.
textureMaxSize 2048 — Khronos 3D Commerce recommendation: 2K; Shopify accepts 4K too but advises optimizing.
drawCalls 25 — guideline: a product card is usually a single object, so keep the primitive count low for a fast display.
vramMB 100 — guideline: storefronts are opened from phones too, so we save video memory.
fileMB 15 — Shopify's recommendation to keep the model compact for fast product-card loading.
noKtx true — v0.0.8: baseline plan without KTX2 (textures stay PNG/WebP); KTX2 is an extension enabled by explicit user choice.
texMode mixed — if the user enables the ktx2 extension: priority is storefront loading speed — color textures in a light format, detail maps in a more precise one.
extension id = core feature name: web-interface passes the selected ids to optimizeFile as advancedFeatures; the opts field is the equivalent for the legacy path.
